'''2000 Hoth Ice Plains Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Hoth Ice Plains region in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rl00hothiceplains">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=hothiceplains 2000 Regionals: Hoth Ice Plains], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010727140735/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=hothiceplains Internet Archive]</ref> The region covered New Brunswick, Newfoundland, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, Quebec.

[[Alex Klammrodt]] of Kirkland, Quebec won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Date:''' 9 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Toronto's Metro Hall (room TBA) 55 John Street Toronto, Ontario Canada
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Blair Beveridge]]
